title: The LoRA cogwheel belongs on the flow RUN stage, not the Library slide-over
description: Fabio, 2026-08-23, after live-testing MPI-610: the per-slot LoRA cogwheel sits in the Flow Library's detail slide-over, which is BEFORE the flow opens. The output is on the final/run stage, so a user iterating on LoRAs has to leave the result, reopen the Library slide-over, change the rack, and walk back. Move the cogwheels onto the run slide, one per rack-bearing model slot, keeping the slide-over's per-slot labelling. Applies to BOTH two-rack flows - character-sheet and scribble-object - and to any future one, so it is a change to how MpiBaseFlow renders a flow's declared racks, not a per-flow edit.
